description: Land Title Settlement Department - Balangoda, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura  District - Cad. Map No.620077
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 109 and No. 116) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extent, owner details, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
